title: No model: say so, offer "Get a model"
problem: Chat, meetings, dictation, voice and the extension let you start, then fail with a generic error when no model is installed.
fix: One readiness line per feature ("Needs a speech model · Get a model") that opens Models on the right tab, on every product. Reuse the Day view pattern.

items.title: Computer asleep: models vanish, chat shows raw error
items.what: When the computer is asleep or closed, the phone model picker removes its models with no reason. A chat that fails posts the raw error and an alert, 'Generation Error'. A good line already exists in the phone's computer search: 'Can't reach {name}. Check it's on and on the same network.' Desktop logs phone requests but has nothing to send while off.
items.risk: The user sees models disappear or a technical error. They do not know to wake the computer.
items.rec: mobile: keep a greyed row '<name> is not reachable' in the picker. Map network failures in chat to the existing line, with Retry.

items.title: No notice when a sent model is ready
items.what: Completion notices cover shared files only. The phone notification list has no model items. Desktop only sends a progress event to its own window.
items.risk: A model of several GB lands. Nothing tells the user or offers 'Open Models'.
items.rec: shared: add a model completion notice, '<model> is ready', with an Open Models action. Both apps already render the notice list.

items.title: Desktop prints raw model-send errors
items.what: The phone translates the duplicate case: '<model> is already installed on <device>. Open Models on <device> to use or remove it.' Desktop prints the engine's message unchanged. Free space is checked on the phone for image models only.
items.risk: A send to the phone fails with technical text. The user does not know the phone is full or already has the model.
items.rec: shared: move transferFailureMessage to shared and add storage-full and disconnected cases. pro: use it in the send dialog.

items.title: Models the other device cannot run are hidden
items.what: Both pickers filter out models the receiver cannot run. The reason text exists in shared and is never shown. Desktop empty state reads 'No OGAM(Off Grid AI Mobile)-compatible models are installed.' even for a Mac target. The phone reads 'No models here can run on that device yet.'
items.risk: The user looks for a model they own and it is missing. No reason, no next step.
items.rec: shared: return blocked models as disabled rows with the reason. Both apps show them greyed. Use one plain empty-state line on both.

items.title: Desktop never says a paired phone uses its models
items.what: Pairing gives the phone a key to this computer's models. The Devices screen does not mention it. The only off switches are Forget, or revoking 'Sync · <device>' in Gateway, API keys. The phone then gets the wrong advice (see dm-gateway-key-revoked-reason-dropped).
items.risk: The desktop user does not know the phone can run models here, and has no clear place to turn it off.
items.rec: pro: one line on the paired device card, 'Can use this computer's models', with a switch. It pairs with the phone-side fix for the revoked key.

items.title: Chat with no model looks ready, then fails
items.what: With no text model the model chip in the composer disappears (it only renders when a model name exists). Send stays live. The reply is a plain text bubble: 'Models not downloaded. Please complete onboarding to download the AI model.' Onboarding is already finished and the bubble has no button. The sidebar dot reads 'Model stopped', not 'No model'. The Active models panel says 'get one in Models' as text with no link.
items.risk: A user who skipped setup or deleted the model has a dead chat and an instruction they cannot follow.
items.rec: When there is no model, keep the chip and label it 'Get a model' (opens Models via the existing og:navigate event). Change the error text to 'No chat model. Get one in Models' with the same link. Give the status dot a 'No model' label. In the Active models panel pass a 'Get one' button as the empty slot content, the way VideoProUpsell already does.

items.title: No speech model reads as 'Transcription failed, retry'
items.what: The engine throws 'No transcription model found — download Whisper from Models first.' Meetings replaces it with a generic 'Transcription failed... retry transcription'. The screen shows 'Transcript not available' with a Retry icon. Record does not check for a speech model first, and the model picker lists installed models only.
items.risk: The user records a whole call, gets no transcript, and Retry fails the same way every time.
items.rec: Pass the real reason through. Reuse the Day view JournalWaitLine pattern: 'Needs a speech model. Get a model' linking to Models. Show the same line beside Record when no speech model is installed.

items.title: Dictation with no model or mic flashes and hides
items.what: 'Start dictation' is always live. With no speech model the overlay shows 'No transcription model installed — download Whisper from Models.' for about 3 seconds, then hides. A denied microphone shows the raw error or 'Microphone unavailable'. Neither has a button. The message says Whisper even when another engine is chosen. Microphone is not a row in Settings > Setup & health > System permissions.
items.risk: A first-time user cannot dictate and gets no path to the fix.
items.rec: Add a readiness row on Voice (speech model, microphone) reusing the TranscriptionModels download list and the existing window.api.openMicrophoneSettings() button from chat. Add a Microphone row to PermissionsPanel. Name the chosen engine in the message.

items.title: Image mode turns on with no image model
items.what: The Image chip always switches image mode on. Sending gives a plain text bubble: 'No image model installed. Download one from Models.' with no link. In the + menu 'Generate image' is greyed out with no reason.
items.risk: The user writes a prompt, waits, and gets a line of text. The other entry is greyed with no word why.
items.rec: Copy the video pattern already in this file: keep the item, dim it, give it a title, and on click open Models on the Image tab (og:navigate with subroute 'image'). Do the same on the chip.

items.title: Video mode in chat starts without a model
items.what: On Pro, video mode switches on even when no complete video model pack is downloaded. The only hint is a hover tooltip. '+ > Generate video' is greyed with no reason. A failed send writes plain text: 'Choose a complete video model in Models, then try again.'
items.risk: The Video screen handles this well; chat does not. Same prompt, different result.
items.rec: In chooseVideoMode, when no video model is ready, call the existing getVideoModel action (the one behind VideoError's 'Get the video model' link) instead of turning the mode on.

items.title: Failed summary shows cut transcript as 'Summary'
items.what: If summarising fails (for example no text model), the error is only logged and the summary is set to the first 280 characters of the transcript. The screen prints it under 'Summary'.
items.risk: The user reads a cut-off transcript as the summary. No reason, no 'summarise again'. The only path is Re-transcribe, which redoes everything.
items.rec: Store no summary on failure. Show the JournalWaitLine line: 'Needs a model. Get a model' or 'Summary failed. Try again'.

items.screen: Chat (memory-chat) mic button and voice mode
items.title: Voice input failure hides the real reason
items.what: The engine gives clear reasons such as 'No transcription model found'. Chat keeps two special cases and otherwise shows 'Transcription failed. Check the speech-to-text model in Settings > Setup & health.' as amber text with no button. Microphone denied does get an 'Open System Settings' button.
items.risk: With no speech model the mic button fails every time, with no route to the fix.
items.rec: Copy the mic-denied alert next to it and add a 'Get a speech model' button that opens Models on the transcription tab. Pass the engine's message through.

items.screen: Extension panel: any 'Update Off Grid AI Desktop' line
items.title: 'Update Desktop' lines give no way to update
items.what: The extension has nine lines that say to update the desktop (chat, tools, vault, models, audio, settings options). None has a button or a link. The desktop never learns the extension version and has no line that says the extension is too old; the pairing request carries only the protocol number.
items.risk: The user reads 'update' and has no next step in the panel. An old extension against a new desktop fails without any word on either side.
items.rec: Extension: put one 'Update Desktop' action on these lines (releases page, or a bridge call that opens the desktop updater). Send the extension version in 'state' and show 'Update the extension' on the desktop paired browser row when it is too old.

items.screen: Panel > Chat with no active text model
items.title: No model: Send is off, no next step
items.what: With no active model the header shows a static "No model" pill. Send and the four starters are disabled with no reason. The model menu is not rendered. The error text says to open Desktop and activate a model, but the panel's own Models screen can do it.
items.risk: A new user sees a chat they cannot type into and a grey pill. Nothing tells them to pick a model or that one tap in Models fixes it.
items.rec: Make the "No model" pill a button that opens Models on the Text tab (onManage already does this). Put one line above the composer: "Choose a model to start" with the same action. Point the no-model error at the panel's Models screen.

items.screen: Panel > Settings > any Desktop-backed tab when Desktop does not answer
items.title: Settings tabs say "pair" when Desktop is just closed
items.what: Eight tabs share one fallback. When the read returns nothing (not paired, or paired but Desktop away) it always says "Pair with Off Grid AI Desktop in Settings > Desktop". It is plain text with no button, and the user is usually paired already.
items.risk: A paired user whose Desktop is closed is told to pair again. They open the Desktop tab, see "Paired", and are stuck.
items.rec: Let DesktopSection read the link state (usePairing already has it). Not paired: show the PairingCard in place. Paired but away: "Off Grid AI Desktop is not running" with Open and Retry.

items.screen: Panel > Writing after a failed Check or Rewrite
items.title: Writing screen failures have no next step
items.what: A failed review shows only the message (offline, not paired, no model, grammar model downloading). A failed rewrite sets a note only. The page overlay for the same failures has "Open Off Grid AI" or "Try again".
items.risk: "No model" in the Writing screen leaves the user to guess that Models is two taps away in the same panel.
items.rec: Give the notice the same actions the page overlay has, plus the in-panel ones: no model opens Models, not paired opens Settings > Desktop, others get Try again.

items.title: Agent is greyed out with no way forward
items.what: When Desktop says the active model cannot run Agent, the item is disabled and its click does nothing. The hint is Desktop's reason, or "Update Off Grid AI Desktop" when none came. Nothing leads to a model that can.
items.risk: The user sees Agent is off and cannot tell which model would turn it on or where to pick one.
items.rec: Make the item open Models on the Text tab, like Create image does, with the hint "Needs a model that supports tools" when Desktop gives no reason.

items.screen: Panel > Models when the list cannot be read or a switch fails
items.title: Models screen errors have no retry
items.what: If the inventory read fails the screen shows one status line ("Off Grid AI Desktop is not reachable.") and an empty list. There is no retry button and no re-read on a timer. A failed switch shows the reason the same way.
items.risk: The user must leave the screen and come back to try again.
items.rec: Add a Retry icon button beside the status line (refresh already exists) and re-read when the panel regains focus.

items.screen: Panel empty states that need a Desktop-only step
items.title: "Do it in Desktop" notes have no link
items.what: Six places tell the user to do something in Desktop and stop: download a model, download an image model, add a remote server, add accounts, edit the system prompt, export the vault. None opens Desktop or the right screen.
items.risk: Each one is a manual trip: find the app, find the screen, come back. Noted here because the user meets them inside the extension; the Desktop side belongs to the cross-product thread.
items.rec: One shared "Open in Off Grid AI Desktop" link for these notes (offgrid://open, with a screen path if Desktop supports one).

items.screen: Desktop guide topic Images -> 'Open Images' -> memory-chat
items.title: Open Images lands on a plain chat
items.what: Images routes to 'memory-chat', the same as Chat. It does not check for an image model or open an image mode. The phone does both: with no image model it opens Models on the Image tab.
items.risk: A desktop user with no image model asks for a picture and gets a text reply. No next step.
items.rec: desktop: route Images to the image mode of chat, or to Models filtered to image when none is downloaded, like useGuideAction 'images'.

items.title: A 'try it' button drops you out of onboarding
items.what: Onboarding step 3 opens the normal guide topic page. Its action button is live. On a new install 'Start a chat' goes to the Models tab and 'Open Projects' goes to the Projects tab. Onboarding is marked done only by its own finish step.
items.risk: You land in the tabs with no model and no setup. On the next launch onboarding starts again.
items.rec: Pass a preview param from onboarding and hide the action button on the topic page, or make the action finish onboarding first.

items.title: 'Not enough space' has no path to free it
items.what: A download that does not fit shows an OK-only alert: 'Free up space in Settings > Storage'. Failed rows in Downloads offer only retry and delete. The Storage screen shows model counts as plain text; only video packs can be deleted there. Its last line says to delete models 'in Models', as text.
items.risk: You read 'free up space', tap OK and must find Storage yourself. Storage then sends you to another tab. Retry fails the same way.
items.rec: Add a 'Free up space' button to the alert and the failed row (the start-picture sheet already has this exact button). On Storage, make the model rows and the last line open Downloads, where each model can be deleted.

items.title: No model: 'go to Models', no button
items.what: With no model, the chat screen and the Chats list say 'Download a model from the Models tab' and show a button only when a model exists. 'No Model Selected' alerts on send, resend and edit have OK only. The Project page hides 'New chat' and still says 'Start a chat'.
items.risk: A new user reads a sentence that names another tab and has only Back. On a new project there is no button and no reason.
items.rec: Give each empty state a 'Get a model' button to the Models tab (the route is already used in chat). Give the alerts a 'Choose model' button that opens the model picker.

items.title: No image model: OK-only alerts, picker has no Browse
items.what: Turning on Image mode with no image model shows 'Download an image generation model from the Models screen' with OK only. The model picker inside chat is opened without the browse action, so its Image tab says 'Download image models from the Models tab' with no button. The Gallery empty state says 'Generate images from any chat' and does not check for an image model.
items.risk: Three places tell you to go to another screen and none takes you there. Video mode beside it already has 'Get a video model'.
items.rec: Copy the video path: a 'Get an image model' button to the Models tab on the Image tab. Pass the browse action to the chat's model picker, as the Chats list already does. Same button in the Gallery empty state.

items.title: Film screens name the missing piece, offer no button
items.what: With no video model and no computer, Story and Animate show one line: 'Choose a video model in Models, or pick your computer.' A place that cannot be used is a disabled pill with a reason only. A film that fails because the computer is not reachable shows the two fixes as text and only 'Try again'. Narration with no voice shows a small grey line while the mic still reads 'Narration on'.
items.risk: You wrote a storyboard and have nothing to tap. The film can also come out with no voice.
items.rec: Add two buttons, 'Get a video model' (Models, Video tab) and 'Connect your computer' (the start-picture sheet already has it). Make the narration line a row that opens Models on the Voice tab.

items.title: Home picture and clip cards can do nothing
items.what: With an image or video model downloaded, the card calls 'start new chat'. That returns without a word when no model is active (for example after 'Eject all'). When it works, it opens a plain chat, not picture or video mode.
items.risk: You tap 'Describe a picture', feel the tap, and nothing happens.
items.rec: Reuse the guide's opener: it opens the chat in image or video mode, or the right Models tab when the model is missing.

items.title: Tools row shows 'N/A' and the tap does nothing
items.what: When the model cannot call tools, the Tools row shows a grey 'N/A' badge. A tap closes the menu and opens nothing. This row is the only way to the Tools screen.
items.risk: Web search and the other tools seem to be missing. There is no reason and no way forward.
items.rec: On tap show one line, 'This model can't use tools', with a 'Choose model' button that opens the model picker.

items.title: Photo on a non-vision model: OK only
items.what: Attaching or sending a photo on a model without vision shows 'Switch to a vision-capable model' with OK only. At send time the missing-vision-file case says 'Open Downloads and tap the wrench' with no button, although the composer version of that alert has 'Open Downloads'.
items.risk: You are told to switch model or open Downloads, and the only button is OK.
items.rec: Add 'Choose model' (opens the model picker, as the memory alert does). Reuse the composer's alert builder at send time so 'Open Downloads' is there too.

items.title: 'Tap to speak' ignores mic and speech model state
items.what: The large mic in Voice mode only toggles recording. It does not check the microphone permission or whether a speech model is installed. Only the small footer mic shows the true state.
items.risk: With the mic refused or no speech model, the big 'Tap to speak' does nothing.
items.rec: Drive the large mic from the same state as the footer mic and reuse its two alerts (Open Settings, Download voice model).
